scripts.check: cargo fmt --check && pnpm sqlx:db && node tools/check-rust.mjs && cargo test --workspace && cargo xtask types --check && pnpm --dir ui check
scripts.fmt: cargo fmt && pnpm --dir ui exec prettier --write .
scripts.sqlx:db: cargo sqlx database reset -y --source crates/db/migrations -D sqlite:target/sqlx.db
scripts.sqlx: pnpm sqlx:db && cargo sqlx prepare --workspace -D sqlite:target/sqlx.db -- --all-targets
